YEM.name: Yemen
YEM.disputed: A civil war has split Yemen. The Houthis hold the capital, Sanaa, while the government most countries recognise works from Aden.

VEN.name: Venezuela
VEN.disputed: Many countries said Venezuela's 2024 election was not fair, so who should lead Venezuela is disputed.

TWN.flag: Flag of the Republic of China.svg
TWN.disputed: Taiwan runs itself, but China says Taiwan is part of China. Only a few countries call Taiwan a country of its own.

SDN.name: Sudan
SDN.disputed: Since 2023, Sudan's army and a rival armed group have been fighting a war over who runs the country.

founded.from: the kingdoms of Castile and Aragon

SOL.name: Somaliland
SOL.disputed: Somaliland has run itself since 1991, but almost no other country says it is a country of its own; they count it as part of Somalia.

STP.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
STP.flag: Flag of São Tomé and Príncipe.svg

VCT.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
VCT.flag: Flag of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.svg

KNA.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
KNA.flag: Flag of Saint Kitts and Nevis.svg

ESH.name: Western Sahara
ESH.disputed: Morocco runs most of Western Sahara, but many of the people who live there want it to be a country of its own. The world hasn't decided.

highest.name: Piton de la Petite Rivière Noire

LBY.name: Libya
LBY.disputed: Since a civil war, two rival governments, one in the west and one in the east, each say they run Libya.

KOS.name: Kosovo
KOS.disputed: Kosovo says it is its own country. Many countries agree, but Serbia and some others say it is part of Serbia.

ISR.name: Israel
ISR.disputed: Israel and the Palestinians have long disagreed about land, borders and who runs some places. Israel calls Jerusalem its capital, but many countries don't agree.

PSE.name: Palestine
PSE.disputed: Palestine is made of two areas, the West Bank and Gaza. Many countries call it a country of its own, and some don't. It has been in a long conflict with Israel.

ATF.name: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
ATF.flag: Flag of the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.svg

CYN.name: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
CYN.flag: Flag of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus.svg
CYN.disputed: Northern Cyprus says it is its own country, but only Turkey agrees. Everyone else says it is part of Cyprus.

CYP.name: Cyprus
CYP.disputed: The northern part of the island is run separately, as Northern Cyprus.

COD.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
COD.flag: Flag of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.svg

COG.name: Republic of the Congo
COG.flag: Flag of the Republic of the Congo.svg

CHN.name: China
CHN.flag: Flag of the People's Republic of China.svg

CAF.name: Central African Republic
CAF.flag: Flag of the Central African Republic.svg

MMR.name: Myanmar
MMR.disputed: The army took power in Myanmar in 2021, and a civil war has gone on since. Many countries do not accept the army as the rightful government.

AFG.name: Afghanistan
AFG.disputed: The Taliban took control of Afghanistan in 2021. Most countries have not recognised them as its government, so its flag and leaders are disputed.

KAS.name: Siachen Glacier
KAS.disputed: India and Pakistan both say this icy land in the mountains is theirs, and both have soldiers there.
